## Names

<a id="cmd_rays"></a>
### [`cmd_rays`](../../../../src/tools/rays.asm#L6) `$0E17`

*routine*

Command 6 (Rays): lines from one centre point. The centre comes from $1168. While a button is down, it draws a line from the centre to the cursor ($2746) at each read. While the buttons are up, a band line in picture_background follows the cursor ($2751). It sets brush_plot_flag to 1 and puts it back at the end. A long press with no touch goes back to the menu ($1493).
